product_one_liner.value: Perceptyx provides organizations with an AI-powered employee-experience platform that turns employee insights into action, behavior change, and workforce capability.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes the platform and its organizational workforce outcomes.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage is the company’s current site, and the cited pricing review reports that perceptyx.com had no pricing page and its /pricing URL returned 404 as of August 2026.

named_customers.notes: All three names appear in the company homepage customer-logo list.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 378 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies Temecula, United States as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Both cited profiles give 2003 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: These two technical posts discuss sentiment-model architecture and engineering work behind the platform; the available excerpts do not independently establish the authors’ job titles, so this is medium-confidence.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal provides API guides and multiple linked reference articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open roles shown on the careers board are in customer success and sales development, not AI, ML, or data science.

model_provider.value: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google (for optional generative-AI features)
model_provider.notes: The company’s AI transparency materials name OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google for optional generative AI; its core discriminative models are described as proprietary.

compliance_certs.notes: The security trust center explicitly claims ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II compliance; FedRAMP is not one of the requested certifications.

last_funding.notes: These funding profiles identify the latest round as an $8 million Series A in November 2019; other databases differ on round presentation, so confidence is medium.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was the November 2019 Series A, outside the 18-month period ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers board has a live Enterprise Sales Development Representative posting.

launched_6mo.notes: Perceptyx announced Perceptyx Anywhere on September 29, 2026 and Develop on May 14, 2026, both within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current leadership page is small and lists the team; the dated executive appointment announcements found are April, May, and June 2025, all before the Nov. 9, 2025–Nov. 9, 2026 window. No departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The sales-development posting names these as CRM or sales-engagement tools whose use candidates should know; the posting does not confirm which are deployed internally.
